dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can see a person's spirit?

dialogues.speaker: Sergeant Lin
dialogues.text: It would be an exaggeration to use the word "see." "Sensing" is more like it.

dialogues.speaker: Sergeant Lin
dialogues.text: After all, I'm from the military. I've dealt with plenty of opponents before.

dialogues.speaker: Sergeant Lin
dialogues.text: Some were excellent assassins who were good at concealing themselves, not showing their weapons until the very last moment.

dialogues.speaker: Sergeant Lin
dialogues.text: I exposed their disguises through the extraordinary presences they had, which they could not quite hide.

dialogues.speaker: Sergeant Lin
dialogues.text: And when I fought the ones that could conceal themselves that way... I just had to do my best to block their attacks.

dialogues.speaker: Sergeant Lin
dialogues.text: Still, I try to avoid being on the back foot as much as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Sergeant Lin
dialogues.text: Anyway, learning to sense these auras is a valuable defensive skill, and the sharper your senses are, the better.
